text_block_list.text: Oh, well, thank you very much.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
I mean, I'm glad I placed, but I can't
shake this
feeling that it's some kind of
fate.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
It wasn't an impressive first place, nor
was it a
close second.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
A steady third place. What can I say? It's
very
"me."
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер
choice_data_list: But it's a great result—there's no denying that.

text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I know. I might not look like it,
but I am
happy about it.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
But thinking about the future, I need to
take it up
a notch. Or two, even.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер
choice_data_list: Let's aim for a solid first next time!

text_block_list.text:
Hey now, let's not go crazy here! Do you
even
know what that means?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
First off, isn't part of your job to treat
me to some
nice sushi to celebrate third
place?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер
choice_data_list:
Then, I'll get you even fancier sushi when you
get first place!

text_block_list.text:
Okay, first it is... No, it's too hard! But
maybe...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Ugh! It's not fair to use sushi like that!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер
